DLC2306:3:t_3:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Hangar～

DLC2306:3:t_3:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$. Looks like you slept well last night.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I heard there was a battle last night...」

DLC2306:3:t_3:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those of us on watch took care of that in no time.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hmm... Such wonderful words, coming so naturally to your lips...」

DLC2306:3:t_3:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$勝平$$! You've mastered the secret of being a classic super robot pilot!」

DLC2306:3:t_3:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's nothing like that. You always make such a big deal out of things, $$ノノ$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Somehow, you seem... different from yesterday, $$勝平$$...」

DLC2306:3:t_3:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「Maybe I am. Last night meant a lot to me.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:18.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A boy grows up and becomes a man... That's rather wonderful, $$勝平$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「But since you're an android, maybe you'll never grow up, $$ノノ$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:20.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I take that back! Anyone who says something so tactless to a lady is still a brat, $$勝平$$!」

DLC2306:3:t_3:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「It doesn't bother me one bit when you call me a brat, $$ノノ$$! So there!」

DLC2306:3:t_3:23.en:
$$タケル$$
「You're lively first thing in the morning, $$ノノ$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:24.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Good morning, $$タケル$$! The morning sun is the perfect match for your refreshing smile!」

DLC2306:3:t_3:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Though we've been up all night.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:26.en:
$$タケル$$
「Well, $$ノリコ$$, $$勝平$$... Shall we have breakfast too?」

DLC2306:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Go get $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$ too, $$勝平$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:28.en:
$$勝平$$
「Got it. After working so hard last night, breakfast is going to taste great.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:29.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-you really do seem different from yesterday, $$勝平$$!」

DLC2306:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Of course he does. He's at an age where he's growing fast.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's right, $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$. I'm joining the grown-ups a little ahead of you.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:33.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't lose to you, $$勝平$$! We'll start with a breakfast eating contest!」

DLC2306:3:t_3:34.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're on. The new me doesn't feel like losing at anything.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:35.en:
$$勝平$$
（$$イチ$$, Dad, Grandpa... And $$万丈$$... I'll work harder than ever.）

DLC2306:3:t_3:36.en:
$$勝平$$
（And next time we meet, I'll show you I've grown up a little.）

DLC2306:3:t_3:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...When you haven't seen a man for three days, look at him with fresh eyes...」

DLC2306:3:t_3:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$勝平$$ may usually seem like a mischievous boy, but he has fought his way through countless sorrows and desperate battles.」

DLC2306:3:t_3:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His growth must have been astonishing in just one night, let alone three days...」

DLC2306:4:t_000:0.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「We'll intercept the Empire here. All units, are you ready?」

DLC2306:4:t_000:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
（This might be the first time I've ever seen $$勝平$$ so down before a battle...）

DLC2306:4:t_000:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
（I'm sorry, $$ザンボット$$ Team... $$勝平$$ is so depressed because I stuck my nose in...）

DLC2306:4:t_000:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm sorry, $$勝平$$... I went on patrol without answering your question.」

DLC2306:4:t_000:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Once I was alone, I thought about it. What $$ノノ$$ meant by a classic hero...」

DLC2306:4:t_000:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「Hear me out, $$勝平$$. It's something embodied in $$ザンボット３$$.」

DLC2306:4:t_000:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「The hopes entrusted to $$ザンボット３$$... No, to all of you, are what everyone longs for. I think that's the proof that you're classic heroes.」

DLC2306:4:t_000:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Those are the hopes entrusted to us...」

DLC2306:4:t_000:16.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「That's enough talk! The enemy's coming!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:0.en:
$$アキラ$$
「We really are close to $$ラース・バビロン$$! They've sent quite a force!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:3.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Depending on how this goes, we'll ask $c's main force for backup.」

DLC2306:4:t_001:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「We can't do something that lame!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ケンジ$$! They put us in charge of the watch!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「We can't wake everyone up when they're sleeping off the day's fighting!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$勝平$$ is right! Let's go, everyone!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:10.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「All right...! We'll drive the enemy back with our own strength! All units, attack!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$勝平$$! I'll explain what I meant after this battle!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Okay! Hearing that has got me fired up!」

DLC2306:4:t_001:13.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「He was so down just a minute ago...」

DLC2306:4:t_001:14.en:
$$恵子$$
「But I think that's one of the good things about $$勝平$$.」

DLC2306:4:t_001:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, $$新地球皇国$$! I'm not letting you disturb everyone's sleep!」

DLC2306:4:t_003:0.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Damn it! We weren't watching that direction at all!」

DLC2306:4:t_005:1.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Don't be reckless, $$勝平$$! Fall back!」

DLC2306:4:t_005:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll be reckless or whatever it takes!」

review.context: The morning epilogue shows Kappei's new confidence, then the combat events explain it: Takeru introduces love, courage and power as the hopes entrusted to Zambot's children, and Kappei refuses to wake the exhausted main force.
decisions: AG's three-day proverb uses fresh eyes to convey rapid personal growth.
Nono's android joke concerns permanent inability to grow, preserving the tactless remark that sparks her retort.
Kappei's line about another meeting remains emotionally literal without adding an explanation of departed family members.
The unfinished commander address and reaction fragments are deliberate source pauses.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
